svg.title: Apartment 5 – floor plan
svg.desc: Floor plan of apartment 5: common room with kitchen, bar and fireplace, 5 bedrooms, bathroom and 2 WCs.
svg.text: from the covered terrace by the stage
common room with kitchen, bar and fireplace · 5 bedrooms · bathroom · 2× WC
beds: 4 double beds + 3 beds (2 in bedroom 1, 1 in bedroom 5)
common room: 5× table with 2 benches · 40 seats in total
entrance from the terrace by the stage or via the entrance hall
areas are room floor areas · red = heating
The entrance hall with stairs (8.6 m²) also leads to apartment 4 and is not included
